title: Meet the people behind the course

blocks.content: Meet the people behind the course
I'm Abidit, and I'll be your instructor. I'm a developer, and I still remember what it felt like to see my first game run. That's the feeling we're going for here.
In this course I'll guide you step by step:

items: We will think first, then we will code.
If something is new, we'll slow down. If something is tricky, we'll break it down.

blocks.content: I'm Nisha Sharma, a technical content writer at Programiz.

I worked on the editing side of this course: simplifying explanations, proofreading, improving clarity, and making sure each chapter feels smooth and easy to follow. I also supported the instructor by reviewing the content as it was built, so the learning experience stays beginner-friendly and consistent.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
